Banana Bread

3 very ripe bananas
1 stick butter, melted
3/4 c sugar (or half brown sugar)
1 egg, beaten
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp baking soda
pinch of salt
1 1/2 c flour
1/2 c chopped walnuts if you want

1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. Stir the melted butter into the bananas.
3. Mix in the baking soda and salt, then the sugar, egg and vanilla.
4. Mix in the flour until just combined. Fold in walnuts.
5. Pour into the loaf pan and bake 55-65 min until a toothpick comes out clean.
6. Cool in the pan 10 min, then turn out onto a rack.
